title: #417 AI and Job
prompt: To what extent do you think artificial intelligence poses a threat to human jobs?

promptSegments.text: To what extent do you think artificial intelligence poses a threat to human jobs?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: AI takes over simple tasks, making people jobless.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: AI takes over simple tasks, making people jobless.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: AI reduces the need for human labor by simplifying processes.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: AI reduces the need for human labor by simplifying processes.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: AI creates new types of work for people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: AI creates new types of work for people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: AI helps workers do their current jobs much better.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: AI helps workers do their current jobs much better.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: AI systems are taking over routine tasks, such as simple queries handled by chatbots, which puts many entry-level jobs in call centers at risk.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: AI systems are taking over routine tasks, such as simple queries handled by chatbots, which puts many entry-level jobs in call centers at risk.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The rapid learning and adaptation of AI mean that many current jobs will become obsolete, forcing workers to constantly learn new skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The rapid learning and adaptation of AI mean that many current jobs will become obsolete, forcing workers to constantly learn new skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: AI will generate numerous new job roles, such as AI trainers and data analysts, demonstrating that it will change the nature of work rather than eliminating it.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: AI will generate numerous new job roles, such as AI trainers and data analysts, demonstrating that it will change the nature of work rather than eliminating it.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: AI enhances existing jobs by taking over repetitive or boring tasks, allowing professionals like doctors to focus more on patient care.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: AI enhances existing jobs by taking over repetitive or boring tasks, allowing professionals like doctors to focus more on patient care.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the extent to which artificial intelligence threatens human jobs by examining both the potential for job displacement and the opportunities for human-AI collaboration.
keyArguments: Artificial intelligence has the potential to automate routine tasks, leading to job displacement in certain industries.
However, AI can also enhance human capabilities and create new job opportunities through human-AI collaboration.
